overview.heading: Hello, {name}
overview.body: Your details, where we deliver, and everything you've ordered.
overview.name: Name
overview.noAddress: No delivery address saved yet — we need one before your first Saturday.
overview.nextDeliveryNone: Nothing scheduled. Subscribe before Friday midnight and your first box arrives {date}.

profile.title: Profile
profile.heading: Your details
profile.body: We use these to pack your order and to find you on delivery morning. Nothing else.
profile.name: Full name
profile.phoneHint: Optional here, required on a delivery address. The rider calls this number.
profile.emailHint: This is how you sign in, so it can't be changed here.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.heading: Delivery addresses
addresses.body: We deliver on Saturdays. Save the address you want your box to arrive at.
addresses.label: Label
addresses.labelHint: Your own word for this place.
addresses.placeHint: Filled in from your PIN code. Change it if it's not right.
addresses.pinBody: Enter your PIN code first and we'll fill in your district and state. Fresh greens reach selected areas; everything else ships across India.
addresses.pinBodySubscription: Enter your PIN code first and we'll fill in your district and state. Weekly plans are fresh greens, delivered in selected areas only.
addresses.pinCheckFailed: We couldn't check that just now. Please try again.
addresses.addressLocked: Check your PIN code above first. The address form opens once we know we deliver there.
addresses.pincodeHint: Six digits. We use it to fill in your district and state.
addresses.notesPlaceholder: Gate code, which floor, where to leave it
addresses.empty: No addresses saved yet. Add one and we'll know where to bring your greens.
addresses.locationHint: Optional, and it stays with this address. A pin helps the rider find the right gate in a large layout.
addresses.located: Location pinned, accurate to about {metres} m.
addresses.locationDenied: Location permission was refused. The address saves fine without it.
addresses.locationError: Couldn't get your location. The address saves fine without it.
addresses.locationUnsupported: This browser can't share a location.
addresses.serviceNote: Enter a PIN code and we'll tell you straight away whether we deliver there.
addresses.confirmRemoveBody: We will forget this address. Any order already placed keeps the address it was placed with.
addresses.limitReached: You have {max, number} saved addresses, the most we keep. Remove one to add another.

outsideArea.heading: We'd love to bring fresh greens to {pincode}
outsideArea.body: Thank you for thinking of us. For now our fresh greens reach a limited area, and your PIN code is just outside it. Seeds, trays, coir and racks ship anywhere by courier — remove the greens from your cart to order those. If you'd still like greens, send us what you'd like on WhatsApp or by email. Our team will look at every request and deliver it if we can.
outsideArea.bodySubscription: Thank you for thinking of us. For now our fresh greens reach a limited area, and your PIN code is just outside it, so we can't start a weekly plan there yet. If you'd still like greens, send us what you'd like on WhatsApp or by email. Our team will look at every request and deliver it if we can.
outsideArea.subject: Order request for PIN {pincode}
outsideArea.prefill: Hi {brand}! I'd like to order fresh greens, but my PIN code {pincode} is outside your delivery area. Here's what I'd like:

orders.title: Orders
orders.heading: Your orders
orders.body: Every subscription and one-off order you've placed, with its delivery date and receipt.
orders.emptyBody: When you subscribe to a weekly box or buy seeds, racks or trays, it appears here.

detail.title: Order
detail.pendingBody: If you finished paying, it can take a minute to reach us. Nothing is lost — check again shortly.
detail.expiredBody: The time to pay for this order ran out without a payment. Your cart is still saved, so you can place it again.
detail.paidHeading: Thank you — your order is placed

stageBody.growing: Your greens are sown just for you and cut on the morning they travel. We pack everything together then, so it all arrives fresh.
stageBody.packing: We're on it. Your order is being packed by hand and goes out as soon as it's ready.
stageBody.ready: Packed and ready. It leaves with the delivery partner next.
stageBody.onTheWay: It's on its way to you.
stageBody.delivered: Delivered. We hope you love it.

errors.recipientRequired: Who should we hand the box to?

errors.placeTooLong: That's longer than any district or state name.
errors.locationInvalid: That location doesn't look right. Pin it again or save without it.
errors.addressLimit: You already have the most addresses we keep. Remove one to add another.
